description: This file implements a comprehensive subtitle generation pipeline from video files, involving audio extraction, speech transcription with Whisper models (including multi-pass and ensemble strategies), translation via M2M100, and subtitle file writing. It contains functions for audio processing, segmentation, transcription, translation, ensemble voting, and main orchestration.

methods.name: extract_audio(video_path)
methods.description: Extracts audio from a video file into a WAV file using ffmpeg.

methods.name: write_subtitles(transcription, sub_format, filename)
methods.description: Writes subtitle segments into SRT or VTT format based on provided transcription data.

methods.name: format_timestamp(seconds, srt=True)
methods.description: Converts seconds into formatted timestamp string suitable for subtitle files.

methods.name: split_audio(audio_path, chunk_length=600, overlap=1.0)
methods.description: Splits large audio files into fixed-length chunks with overlap, re-encoding into 16kHz mono PCM WAV.

methods.name: batch_translate_m2m100(texts, src_lang, tgt_lang, batch_size=8)
methods.description: Performs batch translation of texts using M2M100 in multiple smaller batches to prevent memory issues.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _whisper_param_sweeps(task: str, language: str)
methods.description: Builds combinations of parameters for multi-pass whisper transcription for ensemble diversity.

methods.name: str _normalize_seg_text(text: str)
methods.description: Normalizes segment text for comparison and voting.

methods.name: List[List[Dict[str,Any]]] _align_segment_groups(all_pass_segments: List[List[Dict[str, Any]]], time_tolerance: float = 0.6)
methods.description: Aligns segments from multiple transcription passes into groups based on proximity.

methods.name: Tuple[str,float] _vote_texts(candidates: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs a simple voting ensemble to select a representative text for a segment.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _consolidate_groups(groups: List[List[Dict[str, Any]]])
methods.description: Consolidates aligned groups into final segments with confidence scores using voting.

methods.name: clean_text(text)
methods.description: Cleans up whitespace and trims text.

methods.name: _transcribe_single_chunk_with_params(args)
methods.description: Transcribes a chunk with specified parameters, used in ensemble multi-pass transcription.

methods.name: transcribe_single_chunk(args)
methods.description: Transcribes a chunk with a fixed model, used for older single-pass procedures.

methods.name: merge_overlapping_segments(segments, overlap=1.0)
methods.description: Merges transcription segments from overlapping chunks to prevent duplicates.

methods.name: transcribe_chunks_parallel(chunks, model_size="large-v3", task="transcribe", language=None, enable_ensemble: bool = True)
methods.description: Performs parallel transcription of chunks with optional ensemble, merging results.

methods.name: generate_subtitles(video_path, subtitle_lang)
methods.description: Main pipeline to generate subtitles from a video file, handling audio extraction, transcription, translation, and subtitle formatting.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Orchestrates the process to generate subtitles for a predefined video and saves the output.

methods.name: bool seg_close(a: Dict[str, Any], b: Dict[str, Any], tol: float)
